knowledge:
- key_parameters: file=Path to the input text file (used in read.LC480, read.LC480SampleInfo, and read.qPCR) ;; ...=One or more file paths to SDS output files to be combined (used in read.taqman) ;; read.qPCR columns=Input file must be tab-delimited with mandatory columns 'Sample', 'Detector', and 'Cq', and optional columns 'Well' and 'Plate' (which must be provided together or not at all)
- alternatives: NormqPCR=The complementary package to be used after ReadqPCR for the normalization of qPCR data ;; read.affybatch=Mentioned as a conceptual analog from the affy package for how read.qPCR and read.taqman automatically populate S4 objects
- when_to_use: Use when you have raw RT-qPCR data (either raw fluorescence cycles from Roche LC480 or Cq values from Taqman SDS / generic plates) and need to parse them into R for downstream normalization and differential expression analysis.
- pitfalls: In read.qPCR, Well and Plate columns are optional but must be provided together; providing one without the other is not allowed ;; Duplicate plate IDs with the same Well number are not allowed in read.qPCR ;; If files combined in read.taqman do not have matching detector names, or if duplicate sample or plate names are given, the function will error and stop ;; Cq values are not raw expression values; a lower Cq indicates higher expression. qPCR measures relative, not absolute, quantification ;; read.qPCR can only read one file at a time, unlike read.taqman which can read multiple files.

workflows.name: roche_lc480_loading
workflows.intent: Read raw fluorescence data from Roche LightCycler 480 and merge with sample information.
workflows.stages: 1. Read raw LC480 text file using read.LC480 to create a CyclesSet object ;; 2. Read additional sample information using read.LC480SampleInfo to create an AnnotatedDataFrame ;; 3. Merge the fluorescence data and sample information using merge
workflows.code:
path <- system.file("exData", package = "ReadqPCR")
LC480.example <- file.path(path, "LC480_Example.txt")
cycData <- read.LC480(file = LC480.example)
LC480.SamInfo <- file.path(path, "LC480_Example_SampleInfo.txt")
samInfo <- read.LC480SampleInfo(file = LC480.SamInfo)
cycData1 <- merge(cycData, samInfo)

workflows.name: generic_qpcr_loading
workflows.intent: Read user-formatted tab-delimited qPCR data (with optional Well and Plate columns) into a qPCRBatch object.
input: qPCR.example.txt (tab-delimited text file containing Sample, Detector, Cq, and optional Well and Plate columns)
workflows.stages: 1. Read the user-formatted qPCR file using read.qPCR to create a qPCRBatch object
workflows.code:
path <- system.file("exData", package = "ReadqPCR")
qPCR.example <- file.path(path, "qPCR.example.txt")
qPCRBatch.qPCR <- read.qPCR(qPCR.example)

workflows.name: taqman_sds_loading
workflows.intent: Read Sequence Detection Systems (SDS) software output files (Taqman Low Density Arrays) into a single qPCRBatch object.
workflows.stages: 1. Read one or more SDS files using read.taqman to create a qPCRBatch object
workflows.code:
path <- system.file("exData", package = "ReadqPCR")
taqman.example <- file.path(path, "example.txt")
qPCRBatch.taq <- read.taqman(taqman.example)
taqman.example.second.file <- file.path(path, "example2.txt")
qPCRBatch.taq.two.files <- read.taqman(taqman.example, 
                             taqman.example.second.file)
